title: Bobby Shmurda, LouGotCash & Lee On The Beats Drop ‘GC TO THE SHMURDA’
htmlContent:
Queens, New York-based producer Lee On The Beats just had one of his most significant moments to date with the release of his collab song with Bobby Shmurda and LouGotCash called 'GC TO THE SHMURDA.' The single sits at track number 3 on the duo's newest collab project, 'SHMURDAGOTCASH.'

From the start, Lee On The Beats' producer tag sets the song's energy. Heavy 808s come crashing right after as Bobby Shmurda and LouGotCash showcase their chemistry, delivering unique perspectives in their bars.

The release has been a long time coming, and as a producer, it can get frustrating waiting for artists to drop new music. Lee On The Beats is patient, waiting for his opportunity to show the world what he is made of through numerous upcoming releases. "I have more new music coming out with an upcoming artist from NY, Steph G," said the producer. "Some stuff with Bobby Shmurda & LouGotCash. Another artist named Murkemz, and I've been working with a few other names. I'm waiting for confirmation, so I'd rather not mention it. Oh! I have my music coming out as well," explained Lee On The Beats.

With impressive new producer credits, it's no question that Lee On The Beats is in a great position to elevate from this point forward. The artist's next most significant step will be releasing his own music, which has been in the works for a while now.
